digital-networks-act.text: Telecom challengers including Iliad, Digi, Colt and 1&1 asked for stronger competition safeguards in Michał Kobosko's draft report and a mandatory nationwide switch from copper to fibre.

digital-omnibus-data.text: Member states agreed the Council's negotiating mandate. Talks with Parliament open once Parliament adopts its own position.

industrial-accelerator-act.text: Member states moved closer to agreement on the act's foreign investment chapter. They remain split on Commission waiver powers, the investment threshold and workforce rules, and Ireland aims for a Council position by end of November.

The joint INTA-ITRE-IMCO committee vote remains officially set for 1 December despite more than 5,000 amendments. The EPP is split, and a group around Christian Ehler and Jörgen Warborn wants the proposal rejected.
More than 5,000 amendments were tabled to the joint draft report. Dirk Gotink's amendments would open 'Made in Europe' to all trade and procurement-agreement partners.
The Committee of the Regions adopted its opinion on the act. Its rapporteur is Willy Borsus.

mff-2028-2034.text: More than 1,000 amendments were tabled to the draft Performance Regulation, about 300 on its results indicators. At a joint BUDG-CONT meeting on 4 November, the groups split over the do no significant harm principle.
Member states do not expect António Costa's negotiating box before the last week of November. Diplomats see the 17–18 December European Council as the most likely moment for a deal.

Parliament's Conference of Presidents backed turning committee positions on the Competitiveness Fund, Horizon Europe, fisheries and AgoraEU into negotiating mandates without a plenary vote, likely announced in mid-December.

Agriculture ministers agreed the Council's negotiating mandate on the post-2027 common agricultural policy on 26 October. Farm support would be paid through the National and Regional Partnership Plans.
Parliament's rapporteurs and shadows agreed compromise amendments on the European Competitiveness Fund on 22 October. ITRE is expected to adopt them on 10 November.
